title: Weight
description: Weight as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is a weight target allocated to the installation?
Is a concept weight estimate made?
Are centre of gravity effects identified?
Is the preliminary weight estimate within target?
Is the weight estimate maturity (estimated, calculated, actual) recorded?
Is the calculated weight of the released design within target, or is an overrun recorded as an Issue?
Are weights of all Parts and Assemblies recorded?
Are the weight and centre of gravity reported to the aircraft weight budget?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
